title: Penalties for Offences Related to Illegal Dumping of Toxic Substances into Public Sewers
what_it_is: Penalties for Offences Related to Illegal Dumping of Toxic Substances into Public Sewers

sections.label: Sewer discharge penalties and sensors
sections.summary: Penalties under the Sewerage and Drainage Act and Trade Effluent Regulations match discharge impact, workers must wear protective equipment, non-compliant companies face tender impact, and PUB uses real-time sensors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: The penalties for the illegal disposal of hazardous substances into the public sewerage system are set out under the Sewerage and Drainage Act and Sewerage and Drainage (Trade Effluent) Regulations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Penalties are set to be commensurate with the impact of the discharge on the public sewerage system and NEWater production.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: All workers maintaining the sewerage system are required to don Personal Protective Equipment when performing their work.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Companies which do not comply will be impacted when tendering for future Public Utilities Board (PUB) projects, including possible debarment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: In addition, PUB has put in place an island-wide network of real-time sensors in the public sewerage system to detect hazardous concentrations of toxic substances in used water.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: This provides PUB with the triggers to respond quickly to incidents and ensure the safety of workers.

sections.label: Sharing mitigation measures information
sections.summary: The speaker accepts the suggestion to share information on mitigation measures and their costs to protect the sewerage and NEWater production systems.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: I understand that the Member is asking us to share information on mitigation measures and also on the costs involved in mitigation measures.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: We will definitely take up that suggestion because it is important for not just PUB but the community and the public also to protect our sewerage system and also potentially NEWater production system.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: So, we will definitely take up that suggestion.
